verdict.rationale: Next.js is a full-stack framework, so event-triggered automation is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no product-level rules engine for automatic actions on events. Middleware routing/access rules and API routes for listening to webhooks are developer building blocks for constructing such behavior, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
